name: review-extract-check
summary: For reviewing many documents against rules. Reviewers split the documents and extract facts with quotes, an analyst applies the rules, a writer writes the deliverables, and a checker re-derives every value on their own.

roles.name: lead
roles.job: Splits the documents between reviewers and fixes the fields every extract must have.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.job: Reads its documents (with their amendments and letters) and extracts each fact with the sentence it comes from. Use several reviewers.

roles.name: analyst
roles.job: Applies the rules to the extracts: dates, conversions, violations, actions.

roles.name: writer
roles.job: Writes the deliverables from the analysis.

roles.name: checker
roles.job: Works out every value again from the documents and the rules, without looking at the analysis first, then compares.

steps.do: Assign the documents to reviewers and list the fields to extract.
Each reviewer extracts the facts of its documents, quoting the text, at the same time as the others.
Apply the rules to every extract.
Re-derive every value independently and send differences back.

rules: Every extracted fact quotes the sentence it comes from.
The checker works from the documents, not from the analysis.
